product_overview: Pesantren Platform is a multi-tenant white-label ERP for pesantren communities, with a public central landing experience, staff sign-in, and public-facing admission and informational pages. The application also provides static documentation and legal pages for visitors.
core_goals: Let visitors learn about the platform from the public landing page
Allow staff to sign in with email and password
Enable prospective students to submit a PPDB registration form
Provide public legal, privacy, and contact information pages
Offer a documentation portal for end-user guidance

features.name: Marketing Landing
features.description: A public landing page that introduces the platform and directs visitors to login, documentation, and legal information.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View the platform headline and call to action -> Choose to continue to the staff login page -> Open a legal or informational page from the footer
Navigate to / -> View the platform overview content -> Open the documentation portal -> Browse supporting guidance sections

features.name: Staff/Portal Login
features.description: A branded email-and-password sign-in page for staff and portal users, with validation feedback for user input errors.
user_flows: Navigate to /masuk -> Enter an email address -> Enter a password -> Submit the sign-in form -> See access granted and be redirected to the appropriate panel
Navigate to /masuk -> Leave required fields empty -> Submit the sign-in form -> See validation messages
Navigate to /masuk -> Enter an email address -> Enter an incorrect password -> Submit the sign-in form -> See an authentication error message

features.name: Public PPDB Registration
features.description: A public admission registration form for prospective students to submit their application data.
user_flows: Navigate to /ppdb -> Open the admission registration form -> Fill in applicant information -> Submit the registration form -> See the submission complete successfully

features.name: Legal and Info Pages
features.description: Static public pages that present privacy, terms, disclaimer, cookie policy, contact, and account deletion information.
user_flows: Navigate to /kebijakan-privasi -> Read the privacy policy content -> Go back to the landing page
Navigate to /syarat-layanan -> Read the terms of service content -> Go back to the landing page
Navigate to /disclaimer -> Read the disclaimer content -> Go back to the landing page
Navigate to /cookie-policy -> Read the cookie policy content -> Go back to the landing page
Navigate to /kontak -> Read the contact information -> Go back to the landing page
Navigate to /hapus-akun -> Read the account deletion request information -> Go back to the landing page

features.name: Documentation Portal
features.description: A static end-user documentation area that provides guide sections for users to learn how to use the platform.
user_flows: Navigate to /dokumentasi -> Open the documentation home page -> Browse between guide sections -> Read the instructions for a selected topic

routes.description: Public marketing landing page of the platform (central domain)
Branded staff/portal login (AppLauncher). Email + password sign in, then role resolver redirects to the correct panel
Account deletion request page (Play Store compliance)
Static user-guide documentation portal (served as static files)

known_limitations.issue: Multi-tenant routing is domain based. Tenant admin panels (Filament) and tenant public websites live on subdomains (e.g. demo.localhost), which are not reachable through a single localhost:8000 tunnel. Only the central domain surface (landing, /masuk login, legal pages, documentation) is reliably testable in this setup.
known_limitations.impact: Deep admin navigation, role-based sidebar, and money/transaction flows cannot be reached from the root host and require subdomain access or a per-tenant base URL.

known_limitations.issue: /ppdb and /donasi are tenant-scoped pages; on the central host without a resolved tenant they may redirect or return 404 rather than the full form.
known_limitations.impact: Public PPDB/donation tests may need a tenant subdomain to exercise the real submission flow.

known_limitations.issue: No central super_admin user is seeded in this local instance; the seeded admin (admin@demo.localhost) belongs to the demo tenant database, so a successful login at the central /masuk cannot be exercised without creating a central user.
known_limitations.impact: Login tests are limited to form validation and invalid-credential handling unless a central user is created.
